## Why it matters

This open-access collection brings together South Asian newspapers from Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka, with coverage reaching back to the 1850s.

It is valuable for studying colonial rule, partition, independence movements, and early statehood through multilingual reporting on regional and global events.
